newsitem.title: HONG KONG: ASIL in JV for Beijing property project.
newsitem.headline: ASIL in JV for Beijing property project.

text.p: Asia Securities International Ltd (ASIL) said its Beijing Jing Yuan Property Development Co Ltd unit had agreed to jointly develop a Beijing property with Grand Pacific Holdings Ltd and First Choice Holdings Ltd.

The company said in a statement that Jing Yuan would set up a joint venture with Grand Pacific and First Choice and transfer part of the land use rights and development rights for the 9,517 square metre property in Xidan, in the Xicheng district of Beijing, to the partnership for US$69.66 million.
Profit after tax and minority interest from the transfer would be about HK$35.6 million, Asia Securities said.
Proceeds would be put towards the payment of the outstanding land premium of about HK$78.1 million for the site and development requirements of the property.
The joint venture would be 47.5 percent owned by Grand Pacific, 47.5 percent owned by First Choice -- both independent third parties -- and five percent owned by Jing Yuan.

The new firm would be established to develop shopping arcades in the Xidan area but Asia Securities said there was no current plan to transfer Jing Yuan's other property interests in the Xidan area to the company. The registered capital would be US$10 million with Jing Yuan contributing US$500,000.
Preliminary approval was granted in April for Jing Yuan to build a 12-storey commercial and office building with a total gross floor area of about 110,000 square metres.
Construction costs are estimated at US$110 million, of which Jing Yuan's share has been fixed at about US$36.67 million.
Construction is expected to begin in March and the building is to be completed for delivery of possession on or before December 31, 1999.
Jing Yuan would be entitled to a total office area of not less than 34,500 square metres, it said.
